question: Does reference-based MERT/MuQ cosine distance pass the two-criteria requirement that all prior metrics failed, in particular for note-level errors in 126b?

operator_instruction.text: Score 126c+126b with MERT and MuQ-embed cosine distance (reference-based), score 126a with MERT only, compute S from clean system means, judge win/tie/lose with m=0.10*S, pass=80%.

launch_authorization.scope: MERT-v1-95M + MuQ-large cosine distance scoring: 126c (36,366 FLACs), 126b (87,653 FLACs), 126a (53 variants x 5 systems x 5,131 clips on-the-fly); S from clean system means; m=0.10*S; pass=80%; NVMe peak < 400 MB extra; wall time < 7h. No generation, no training.

completion_evidence.method: guest writes terminal with sha256 of the registered summary after --validate-only passes

fixed_protocol.judgment: pairwise: d = cosim(L2_norm(mean_pool(embed(case))), L2_norm(mean_pool(embed(clean_base)))) - 1 (126a: clean_base = same clip, same system, untransformed lvl30); tie if |d|<=m, lose-correct if d<-m; m=0.10*S per embedder; S = range over 5 TTM systems of mean cosim(clean clip, system centroid) (S_mert from r1 s_values_mert.json; S_muq same definition); pass=80%; 126b/126c items with base=='' and kinds soft/floor/descriptive/ref are descriptive only

resume.note: TSV-level autoresume: 126c/126b TSVs from r1 reused; s_values_muq.json skip if present; 126a unit-level: skip if {OUT}/126a/{vname}/{system}/mert_cosim.tsv exists (written via tmp+rename)

revision_history.note: r1 crashed in score_126a (A.variants() returns dicts; ValueError unpack). r2: 126a pairwise vs same clean clip with CPU pool transforms; S_muq computed; analyze grouped by case, MuQ judged with m_muq.
